description_en: Publishes a live stream, changes the live stream status to streaming, and retrieves the push and pull stream URLs
description_zh: 发布直播，将直播状态转变为直播中，并获取推拉流地址
kebab_example: aliyun imp publish-live --live-id b7f20000ebb3 --user-id as0000hs --region cn-hangzhou
name: PublishLive

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the live stream resource
parameters.name: live_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID, which must be unique within the AppId. The ID can contain lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and periods (.). The maximum length is 32 characters
parameters.help_zh: 用户UserId，在AppId下单独唯一。小写英文、数字、下划线（_）和小数点（.）组成，最大长度32个字符
parameters.name: user_id
